dateline: Las Vegas, NV — Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere now lit in BTS ARIRANG crimson; 'BTS: The City Arirang' festival live; Allegiant Stadium shows begin tomorrow (May 23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,726: Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere Lights Up in BTS ARIRANG Crimson — First Allegiant Stadium Show Tomorrow
heroSubtitle: May 22, 2026 is Day 4,726 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere — the world's largest exterior LED display — began showing BTS ARIRANG-themed visuals tonight, running nightly through May 28. The launch is part of 'BTS: The City Arirang,' the largest city-linked K-pop campaign in history (Global The City 2.0). An official Welcome Party at Tailgate Beach Club and a fan event at La Mona Rosa in Downtown Las Vegas welcomed the global ARMY community ahead of tomorrow's first Allegiant Stadium ARIRANG World Tour show. Local businesses across the Strip, Chinatown, and the Convention Center district reported full occupancy and surging demand as an estimated 200,000+ fans converge on Las Vegas for four shows (May 23, 24, 27, 28). On the charts, 'SWIM' holds its record 6th No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. U.S. (surpassing Taylor Swift) and ARIRANG remains at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 for a third consecutive week. BTS appears at the 52nd American Music Awards on May 25 at MGM Grand Garden Arena.
